jobs.title: Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.description:
For our business partner, a **leading international healthcare and diagnostics services provider**, we’re looking for an experienced **Full Stack .NET Developer** ready for a role where technology, complexity, and real-world impact come together.

You’ll join a mature **internal software development organisation with 15+ years of experience**, contributing to large-scale platforms that support clinics, hospitals, and laboratories across Europe.

If you’re passionate about clean, thoughtful development, enjoy evolving complex and high-traffic applications, and value an **Agile, collaborative, and international environment**, we’d love to meet you.

**Hybrid working model:** 1 day/week in the office, with flexibility.

**Sounds like your kind of challenge?**  
**Send us your CV and let’s chat! We’d love to hear more about you.**

##### **What You'll Be Working On**

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using modern .NET (Core8).
* Contribute to the modernization of legacy applications (.NET 4.8) towards newer architectures.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Architects to shape technical solutions.
* Take full ownership of features — from implementation through to production support.
* Investigate and resolve production issues with a clear understanding of business impact.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared engineering standards.
* Proactively report progress and risks to the Team Lead and Product Owner.
* Occasional travel abroad — a few days every three months.

##### **What We're Looking For**

* **Minimum 5 years of experience in Full Stack Development** (backend .NET + modern frontend)
* Strong experience with **C# and .NET (Core 8**).
* Experience in maintaining or modernizing .NET 4.8 legacy applications.
* Solid understanding of REST API design principles.
* Hands-on experience with MS SQL Server — queries, transactions, and performance tuning.
* Practical exposure to frontend technologies — **Angular 12+ or React**.

##### **Great to Have (But Not a Dealbreaker)**

* Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals.
* Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Azure DevOps — CI/CD pipelines and Git workflows.
* NoSQL databases — MongoDB or Redis.

##### **The Mindset That Fits**

*Technical skills matter — but so does how you work. You'd be a great fit if you're:*

* Quality-driven — you write clean, testable, and maintainable code.
* Ownership-minded — you care deeply about what you ship.
* Comfortable in Agile, cross-functional, international teams.
* Aware of performance, security, and reliability implications.
* Able to work independently and contribute meaningfully to technical decisions.
* A plus: experience mentoring others and navigating complex systems.

##### **What's In It For You**

* Friendly, Agile work environment with cross-functional and international teams.
* Modern tech stack in a dynamic, continuously evolving software environment.
* Clear professional development roadmap within a growing healthcare organization.
* Access to technical & soft skills training, certifications, conferences, and IT events.
* Private medical subscription for you and your children.
* Increasing annual leave (21 26 days) plus a fixed holiday bonus.
* Childbirth support, internal referral program, and annual team-building activities.
* Great office location — right next to a metro station.

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst with .NET Background
jobs.description:
Who we are
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Analyst (Technical BA) with strong expertise in .NET applications, database analysis, and business analysis practices. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding existing applications by analyzing source code, database structures, integrations, and business processes. The individual will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, QA teams, and project managers to translate business requirements into detailed technical user stories, functional specifications, and solution documents.
  
  
This role requires a unique combination of technical depth and business analysis skills to support application enhancements, modernization initiatives, and ongoing support activities.
  
  
What youll be doing
  
  

* Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Analyse existing .NET applications, APIs, services, integrations and database structures to understand system functionality and dependencies
* Review C#, .NET and SQL implementations to support reverse engineering of existing application functionality and business rules
* Analyse data flows, database schemas, stored procedures, views, SQL jobs and system dependencies
* Perform impact analysis for change requests, enhancements and defect resolution
* Facilitate requirement gathering sessions and discussions between business stakeholders, Developers, Architects, QA teams and Project Managers
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE processes, workflows, system interactions, data mappings and integration requirements
* Develop functional and technical specifications that provide clear guidance to development teams
* Collaborate with technical teams to identify solution approaches, dependencies, constraints and implementation impacts
* Support system integration analysis across applications, APIs, databases and external platforms
* Contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, requirement prioritization and delivery activities
* Support QA teams with requirement clarification, test scenario preparation, UAT and defect triage
* Create and maintain project documentation including user stories, process flows, technical specifications, data mappings and design decisions
* Ensure requirements remain clear, traceable and aligned throughout the delivery lifecycle

What youll bring along
  
  

* Bachelors degree in Informatics or similar field of study, or equivalent working experience
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst or similar role
* Strong experience analyzing Microsoft .NET Framework / .NET Core applications
* Ability to read and understand C#, ASP.NET MVC / Web API and .NET Core implementations
* Strong SQL knowledge, including queries, stored procedures, database schemas, views and database dependencies
* Experience with SQL Server, data modelling, database design concepts and data interfaces
* Good understanding of REST APIs, application integrations and system data flows
* Proven experience performing technical analysis, impact analysis and application reverse engineering
* Strong experience with requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria and functional specifications
* Experience documenting AS-IS and TO-BE processes, technical workflows and data mappings
* Ability to facilitate discussions between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams
* Advanced knowledge of Agile / Scrum methodology
* Experience with Azure DevOps or Jira, Confluence, Visio / Draw.io and SQL Server Management Studio
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and documentation skills
* Well-structured and organised working methodology
* Excellent English verbal and written skills

jobs.title: Sr Software Development Engineer, Buyer Safety Experience
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

“WARNING: Choking Hazard — small parts. Not for children under 3 years.”  
  
“WARNING: This product can expose you to chemicals including antimony trioxide, which are known to cause cancer or birth defects or other reproductive harm.”  
  
Have you ever seen these warning labels on popular and seemingly innocent products, such as fidget spinners or food containers? As the Buyer Safety Experience team for Amazon Retail worldwide, we aim to raise the bar when it comes to educating and empowering consumers about product safety. Our team is responsible for the complete end-to-end safety experience for buyers — from the warnings you see on the product detail pages (and how to turn them into useful, actionable information), to making safer product recommendations targeted to each individual consumer’s needs, to informing consumers of recalled products and preventing them from being delivered to their doorstep.  
  
As the founding engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience - Romania team, you’ll be able to build the groundwork and influence its direction for the years to come. Our work cuts across various disciplines — from delivering an awesome customer and brand experience via great UI/UX, to building massively scalable distributed systems to support the most high-traffic pages on Amazon worldwide, to analytical and feedback systems which give us data-driven customer insights, to using GenAI to enable Selling Partners and brands to keep customers safe and informed. If you have a passion for both consumer and business-facing applications, and are obsessed with customer experience, we want you!  
  
Key job responsibilities  
  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in Romania, you will hire and lead a brand new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.  
  
A day in the life  

* Hiring: Build a new team from scratch
* Deeply understand technical decisions, influence long-term architecture
* Define the team's yearly goals and long-term technical vision and charter, along with product and business stakeholders
* Work closely with international stakeholders across our VP-level Trustworthy Shopping Experience org, in addition to TPM and PM-T

  
Key job responsibilities  
As the first Software Development Engineer of the Buyer Safety Experience team in RO, you will hire and lead a new team, and work closely with cross-functional stakeholders worldwide across Program and Product. Your role will be heavily customer-obsessed, building solutions to ensure Amazon is Earth's safest place to shop.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
* Experience in development in the last 3 years

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

  
Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy\_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: (Senior) Software Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**About us**

ebiscon is a software development and IT consulting company with offices in Cologne and Athens. We analyse our customers' business processes and develop tailor-made digital solutions for them – web and mobile applications, cloud services on Microsoft Azure, e-commerce solutions with Shopware and Salesforce solutions.

Most of our customers are mid-size companies in Germany, from industries such as e-commerce, retail, laboratory supply and e-mobility. We support them from the first idea through development to ongoing operation, and often work with them for many years. In addition, we develop our own software platform for the e-mobility market.

**Your role**

You will mainly work for one of our key customers: a leading European group in laboratory supply and wholesale.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you take ownership of your topics: from understanding the requirement to a solution that runs reliably in production. You do not wait for someone to tell you what to do next – you drive your topics forward, make decisions within your area and stand behind the result. From time to time, you will also support our own e-mobility platform.

We work AI-first. Most of our code is no longer written by hand but generated with AI coding agents such as Claude Code – based on clear specifications and verified by you before it goes live. Your value lies less in typing code than in understanding the problem, steering the AI precisely and judging whether the result is correct, secure and maintainable.

**Your responsibilities**

* Take full responsibility for your topics – from the requirement to production and beyond
* Understand the business processes behind a requirement and raise questions or concerns early
* Turn requirements into clear specifications and implement them with AI coding agents
* Review AI-generated code thoroughly – security, authorization, data exposure, error handling – and only merge what you fully understand
* Design backend services, APIs and integrations with C# / .NET, e.g. between e-commerce, ERP and logistics systems
* Estimate and commit to your tasks in grooming and deliver them reliably – and speak up early if a commitment is at risk
* Present your results in the regular reviews with the project team and the customer
* Take part in code reviews and work according to our engineering standards (clean architecture, automated testing, CI/CD, secure development)
* Keep technical documentation up to date and support releases

**Your profile**

* At least 5 years of professional experience in backend development with C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core)
* Experience in building and operating production systems
* Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as your primary way of developing – and a clear sense of where not to trust them
* You take ownership: you have driven topics independently and are used to being accountable for the result
* Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL or SQL Server) and REST APIs
* Experience with integrating third-party systems such as ERP, PIM or logistics systems
* Good understanding of automated testing, CI/CD and secure software development
* Experience with Docker and cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure
* Ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people
* Structured, independent way of working and clear written communication
* Fluent English; German is a plus

**Nice to have**

* Experience with B2B e-commerce, wholesale or order management processes
* Shopware experience
* Experience in an IT services or agency environment
* Salesforce integrations
* Azure certifications
* Front-end experience with a modern framework

**Working model**

* Hybrid work in Athens
* Agreed core hours for team and customer meetings
* Occasional travel to Cologne, e.g. for project kick-offs

**What we offer**

* Long-term work for a key customer, with real influence on their systems
* A high degree of responsibility and direct contact with the management
* Flexible working hours
* Monthly meal vouchers
* Annual learning budget for training, certifications and AI tools

**How to apply**

Please apply via Indeed or send your CV together with your salary expectations and notice period to career@ebiscon.de.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: Up to 60,000.00€ per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Αθήνα
